name: ship
description: Use this for ANY substantive code change you intend to land in the repo — features, refactors, deletions/cleanups, bugfixes, dependency bumps. Do NOT judge fit by the step names: "plan" and "open PR" describe HOW it runs, not WHICH tasks qualify. A deletion or cleanup benefits from the plan → implement → validate → PR pipeline just as much as a feature does. The only tasks that should skip it are pure read-only investigation, answering questions, and trivial one-liners with no real risk. When in doubt, prefer running this over ad-hoc edits.
